"""Remaining domain corners: provenance, budgets, template substitution."""
import hashlib
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from main import run
from modules.byte_program import hash_bytes

failures = 0


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got ', str(got)[:500])
        print('  want', str(want)[:500])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


def doc(seed='s', definitions=(), cases=(), events=(), channels=(), timeout=5):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': [list(r) for r in definitions],
            'timeout_ms': timeout, 'cases': list(cases), 'events': list(events),
            'channels': list(channels)}


def case(name, frames=(), method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': list(frames),
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}


REQ = 'GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'


# zero length parts still appear in committed
row = run(doc(channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [
    {'case': None, 'data': ''}, {'case': 'x', 'data': ''}]}]))
check('empty channel', (row['channels'][0]['committed'], row['channels'][0]['error'],
                        row['channels'][0]['bytes']), ([0, 0], None,
                                                       {'n': 0, 'h': '0000000000000000'}))

# datagram-only case owning a request -> unsent flag
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': 'ab'}])],
              channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': 'x', 'data': REQ}]}]))
check('datagram owner unsent',
      (out['requests'] if False else out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'],
       out['cases'][0]['flags'], out['cases'][0]['origin_count']),
      (['unsent'], ['unsent_origin'], 1))

# extra flag on the second request of the same owner
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [['a', 'b']],
                                 'End_Stream': True}])],
              channels=[{'name': 'c1', 'parts': [{'case': 'x', 'data': REQ}]},
                        {'name': 'c2', 'parts': [{'case': 'x', 'data': REQ}]}]))
check('extra across channels',
      [row['flags'] for ch in out['channels'] for row in ch['requests']],
      ([], ['extra']))
check('extra origin flag', out['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])
check('origin count', out['cases'][0]['origin_count'], 2)

# unattributed request keeps no owner label
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [])], channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [
    {'case': None, 'data': REQ}]}]))
check('unattributed', (out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'],
                       out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owner'],
                       out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'],
                       out['cases'][0]['flags']),
      (['unattributed'], None, [[None, 24]], []))

# identity comparison: host case folding is allowed
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [['a', 'b']],
                                 'End_Stream': True}], method='GET', target='/a',
                        host='H.Example')],
              channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': 'x',
                                                 'data': 'GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n'}]}]))
check('identity case folding', out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], [])

# mixed owner attribution with a null-labelled middle part
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [['a', 'b']],
                                 'End_Stream': True}])],
              channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [
                  {'case': 'x', 'data': 'GET /a HTT'},
                  {'case': None, 'data': 'P/1.1\r\nHost: '},
                  {'case': 'x', 'data': 'h\r\n'}]}]))
row = out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('mixed attribution', (row['owners'], row['flags'], row['owner'],
                            out['cases'][0]['flags']),
      ([['x', 15], [None, 13]], ['mixed_owner'], 'x', ['mixed_origin']))
check('committed with split request', out['channels'][0]['committed'], [0, 0, 1])

# random string substitution: two occurrences, coordinate bound
token0 = hashlib.sha256(b's/case/0/frame/0/data/0').hexdigest()[:20]
token1 = hashlib.sha256(b's/case/0/frame/0/data/1').hexdigest()[:20]
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'data',
                                 'data_to_transfered': 'a<<random_string>>b<<random_string>>'}])]))
expect = ('a' + token0 + 'b' + token1).encode()
check('random tokens', out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], len(expect))
check('random token fingerprint', out['cases'][0]['sent'],
      {'n': 13 + 8 + len(expect) + 1,
       'h': '%016x' % hash_bytes(b'\x00' * 7 + b'\x01' + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00D'
                                 + len(expect).to_bytes(8, 'big') + expect + b'\x01')})

# coordinate differs per frame index and per case index
other = hashlib.sha256(b's/case/1/frame/0/data/0').hexdigest()[:20]
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '<<random_string>>'}]),
                     case('y', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '<<random_string>>'}])]))
check('distinct coordinates',
      out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'] != out['cases'][1]['payload_bytes'], False)
check('coordinate payload length', (out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'],
                                    out['cases'][1]['payload_bytes']), (20, 20))

# header name/value coordinates
name_hash = hashlib.sha256(b's/case/0/frame/0/h/0/n/0').hexdigest()[:20]
value_hash = hashlib.sha256(b's/case/0/frame/0/h/0/v/0').hexdigest()[:20]
out = run(doc(cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'headers',
                                 'data_to_transfered': [['<<random_string>>',
                                                         '<<random_string>>']]}])]))
check('header coordinates', out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], len(name_hash) + len(value_hash))

# expression templates keep tokens literal
out = run(doc(definitions=[['A', '"<<random_string>>"']],
              cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '{{A}}'}])]))
check('token inside expression is literal', out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], 18)

# marker inside an ordinary literal is not an expression
out = run(doc(definitions=[['A', 'b"xy"']],
              cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': 'q{{A}}'}])]))
check('marker inside literal', out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], 6)

# slice across a huge repeat is expanded lazily but stays correct
out = run(doc(definitions=[['B', 'b"ab" * %d' % (10 ** 11)], ['C', 'B[3:9]']],
              cases=[case('x', [{'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': '{{C}}'}])]))
check('sliced repeat', (out['cases'][0]['payload_bytes'], out['cases'][0]['sent']['n']),
      (6, 8 + 4 + 1 + 8 + 6 + 1))

# request budget
big = '{{R}}'
out = run(doc(definitions=[['R', 'b"GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n" * 20001']], channels=[
    {'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': big}]}]))
check('request budget', out, {'error': 'input'})
out = run(doc(definitions=[['R', 'b"GET / HTTP/1.1\\r\\n\\r\\n" * 20000']], channels=[
    {'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': big}]}]))
check('request budget max', len(out['channels'][0]['requests']), 20000)

# chunk line budget
out = run(doc(definitions=[['R', 'b"0\\r\\n" * 40001'],
                           ['H', 'b"POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n"']],
              channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{H + R}}'}]}]))
check('chunk budget', out, {'error': 'input'})
out = run(doc(definitions=[['R', 'b"0\\r\\n" * 40000'],
                           ['H', 'b"POST / HTTP/1.1\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n"']],
              channels=[{'name': 'e', 'parts': [{'case': None, 'data': '{{H + R}}'}]}]))
check('chunk budget max', (out['channels'][0]['error'],
                           out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']['n']),
      ({'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, 0) if False else
      ({'kind': 'syntax', 'offset': 0}, 0))

print('edge: %d failures' % failures)
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
